t: You're at the Church of St Mary the Virgin in Lewisham. Several people of note are buried here. The zoologist John Edward Gray lies here, as does Maria Emma Gray, an English conchologist, algologist and scientific illustrator. There is also William Lushington, who was Member of Parliament for the City of London from 1795 to 1802. William Langford, a Canon of Windsor, is buried here too. So are Robert Wissett, a clerk for the British East India Company, and Mary Stanhope, who died in 1717. It is a church with a long and varied list of burials.
